composition_subtypes.role: Identify connected components and compute minimum cost per component
Sort component minimum costs and apply greedy connection formula

payload.core_composition_summary: Union-Find to aggregate per-component min costs, then sort and greedily compute minimal connection cost.
payload.rationale: DSU groups planets and tracks min cost per group. Greedy sorting selects global minimum and sums costs with (k-2)*min to connect components optimally.
